question: Admit this POC (profile poc) with the five criteria, non-goals, a 1-day budget and the stop conditions as written? Approving accepts all of them as written, including the 1-day budget, enters implementation, and lets FO move the dev2-poc workflow checkout to origin/main (the dispatch precondition reported by workflow_checkout.py); each outward action still asks first.

artifacts.summary: Probe whether Paseo Hub plus a Paseo daemon in Docker can replace r1's internet-facing inbox, trigger repository and GitHub-hosted runner and add live conversation: one deliveryKey sent twice gives one run; the run files an ops task and Draft PR with only a Hub-minted token that cannot push main or merge; the container holds no other credential; the Captain talks to the agent from the Paseo app; an event to a stopped daemon is refused visibly.
